name: Mikage Masora
source:
A second-year student at Narahama High School.

Upon closer inspection, she's a beauty to behold, though she tends to be rather absent-minded, further lacking both friends in class and any sort of presence wherever she goes.

She isn't mute, and on the contrary, easily falls into longwinded discussion on the topic of urban legends. In fact, it isn't terribly uncommon for any surrounding listeners to get profusely tired of this ditzy girl's demonstrations.
